title: Keep check-generated artifacts from blocking exact verification
description: The first live runtime task ran the required dashboard gate and rewrote five tracked QA-owned PNG reports. The next TORCH gate refused WORKTREE_DIRTY. Archive proof outputs outside the tested tree, bind them to exact commit and permit only explicit narrowly scoped check-owned cleanup. Do not stash or commit generated baselines. Add a regression for artifact-generating check sequences while preserving user edits and frozen inputs. Ensure actual code progress uses revisioned task state rather than staying assigned through code commits.
acceptanceCriteria: Required check sequences finish without changing tracked expectations or losing evidence
Generated artifact bytes and exact-commit provenance remain recoverable
Preexisting/user edits are preserved; only proven check-owned changes may be restored
Task progress and blockers reflect the current lifecycle
